name: Mise Studio
description: Mise Studio is a commercial kitchen design theme crafted for planning studios, hospitality consultants, and technical design practices. Built around a calm, documentary aesthetic, it features structured room sheets, transparent fee schedules, and full-scale layout test workflows. Designed with responsive sans typography and clear booking paths to turn kitchen visits into completed commissions.
